title: control registry
description: The one control registry file, controls/registry.json: a version and a list of control rows. Each row says what one control guards against, how it is tested, who owns it and when it is removed. The Rust loader in core/rust/harness/src/control.rs is the validator; a test pins this file's required set and enums to the loader's.

controls.description: Row ids are unique across the list.

kind.description: Closed list. A later ticket widens it when the first non-hook row lands.

baseline_ref.description: Required when the class is orchestration, forbidden otherwise.

enabled.description: The only on/off switch. The hooks.json generator emits enabled rows only.

failure.description: The failure mode the control guards against.

test.description: Repo-relative path of the test that proves the control works. Must exist.

retirement_test.description: The measurable condition under which the control is removed.

hook.description: Required when the kind is hook, forbidden otherwise.

manifest.description: Repo-relative path of the hook's manifest; its event and tools must equal this row's.

tools.description: Joined with a pipe into the hook matcher.
